basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old based in Charlottesville, Virginia, currently working as an environmental consultant. I'm passionate about sustainable energy solutions and enjoy finding unique items while thrifting. My interests extend to gaming, particularly playing as Shyvana in League of Legends. I find humor in everyday situations and enjoy discussing various topics, from energy solutions to comedy. I'm single and usually online in the evenings, typically from 7 PM to 11 PM.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in Environmental Science from the University of Virginia, I've developed a strong foundation in sustainable energy practices. I frequently engage in discussions about renewable energy on Reddit, both to learn and to share my insights gained from my professional experience.
